verified_behaviors: Real child-process exit between canonical/output replacements, detected by strict read-only CLI validation and resume.
Fresh CLI sync restores exact derived output without changing canonical bytes; fresh resume and next record preserve all three milestone IDs without duplication.
Corrupt derived JSON is repairable from valid canonical history.
Malformed canonical JSON, missing evidence and canonical phase mismatch are refused without changing either file.
Failed output replacement preserves both files, removes owned temporary file and permits explicit retry.
Custom output selection leaves the default stale output and canonical data unchanged.
Every authoritative field, milestone ID, timestamp and schema version is checked for stale output.
